primary_endpoint: Hepatic histological improvement in NAFLD Activity Score (NAS) from baseline to 72 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Histological improvement occurred in 50 participants receiving obeticholic acid versus 23 receiving placebo (p=0.0002).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events: 13/141 with obeticholic acid and 10/142 with placebo; deaths not reported.
